speaker.basis: settled 2026-10-02 from fresh-translation review: Generic New Earth Empire soldier (male): 'soldier of the Empire', serves His Majesty the Emperor and a Supreme Commander, sides with the Sidereal, hunts Gundams and Z-BLUE; same bank as g122 (voice_new g122_02 uses $$皇国兵$$); Jigoku's Gyunei Guss (Jagd Doga) is only the reused lines

proposed_by_v_g124_00.basis: Generic New Earth Empire soldier (male): 'soldier of the Empire', serves His Majesty the Emperor and a Supreme Commander, sides with the Sidereal, hunts Gundams and Z-BLUE; same bank as g122 (voice_new g122_02 uses $$皇国兵$$); Jigoku's Gyunei Guss (Jagd Doga) is only the reused lines

proposed_by_v_g124_01.basis: Generic Sidereal soldier/ship officer: calls his captain and His Majesty, 'Sidereal is immortal', demotion if ship lost, calls enemies Earthlings/rebels; not Gyunei (Jigoku wrong)

proposed_by_v_g124_02.basis: Same bank as g122: New Earth Empire soldier/officer who calls the enemy Earthlings, serves the Emperor and Supreme Commander, scorns Gundam; some lines are ship-bridge orders (本艦, 隔壁閉鎖). Jigoku's Gyunei Guss is wrong

proposed_by_v_g124_03.basis: Imperial (New Earth Empire) warship/gun crew: protects Wrath Babylon and His Majesty, calls the Empire 皇国, rebels/stray dogs; not Gyunei Guss. Differs from Jigoku.

124:430.en: 「I'll teach you how foolish you are!」

124:506.en: 「Defy us and you'll get no mercy!」

124:717.en: 「There's no place for you on Earth!」

124:756.en: 「We purge those who defy the Emperor!」

124:870.en: 「We crush the enemies of the Empire!」

124:984.en: 「I'll teach you the power of my ship!」

124:1052.en: 「Drop them before they close! Got it?」

124:1747.en: 「Run, and I'll shoot you in the back!」

124:1891.en: 「I'll show you the gap in skill!」

124:1939.en: 「If I charge in all at once!」

124:2053.en: 「I'll make my name downing a $$ガンダム$$!」

124:2119.en: 「Down a $$ガンダム$$, their morale drops!」

124:2160.en: 「Strike the $$ガンダム$$, symbol of revolt!」

124:2284.en: 「$$ガンダム$$!\nStrike before that firepower's used!」

124:2461.en: 「I'll test how strong that power is!」

124:2555.en: 「Even if a child is piloting,\nI won't hold back!」

124:2772.en: 「A beast needs to be broken in!」

124:2928.en: 「The sun is with us, the $$サイデリアル$$!」

124:2965.en: 「The sun shines for the $$サイデリアル$$!」

124:3008.en: 「A robot using the power of the sun!」

124:3039.en: 「A robot from $$ギシン星$$\nsides with Earth?!」

124:3113.en: 「I won't fall for their smooth talk!」

124:3148.en: 「Seeing a robot from $$ビアル星$$\nin a place like this!」

124:3199.en: 「A body this huge! I can't miss!」

124:3271.en: 「Why, on the galaxy's frontier,\nis there a $$マシンキャリバー$$?!」

124:3363.en: 「Trying to toy with me via mobility?!」

alternatives: I'll swat you down, you little gnat!

124:3587.en: 「What can such a tiny machine do?!」

124:3665.en: 「That's the rumored $$熱気バサラ$$ and\n$$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$?!」

124:3722.en: 「Damn! Am I having a bad dream?!」

124:3765.en: 「What is that one?! What the hell?!」

124:3917.en: 「Hit the bridge or engine to drop it!」

124:3958.en: 「The Earth side's $$スフィア・リアクター$$!」

124:3995.en: 「The power of the $$スフィア$$\nwill all belong to the $$サイデリアル$$!」

124:4153.en: 「Just land a hit! Lay down a barrage!」

124:4233.en: 「Don't flinch at a Super Robot name!」

124:4665.en: 「Run and I'll shoot you in the back!」

124:5001.en: 「I'm honored to be the shield of\nHis Majesty the Emperor!」

124:5180.en: 「Stay out! I'm enough on my own!」

124:5271.en: 「I leave the finishing blow to you!」

124:5425.en: 「Not good! I can't counter like this!」

124:5462.en: 「What humiliation!\nI can only watch the enemy go?!」

124:5640.en: 「If we don't move, the next one hits!」

124:6050.en: 「Not as good as the rumors, Gundam!」

124:6083.en: 「Even a Gundam is only this much!」

124:6143.en: 「A gnat like you is nothing to fear!」

124:6180.en: 「Your best in a weak unit, for this!?」

124:6223.en: 「Not worthy of the name, Super Robot!」

124:6266.en: 「However strong you are,\nI'm fine if I avoid a direct hit...!」

124:6379.en: 「I'll just stop it with my field!」

124:6571.en: 「Just a scratch! The mission goes on!」

124:6709.en: 「I can't worry over a little damage!」

124:6777.en: 「Lay down a barrage! Keep them away!」

124:6818.en: 「Hurry and check where we were hit!」

124:7532.en: 「All hands, stay calm!\nWe still hold the upper hand!」

124:7622.en: 「Strong!\nThe power of Gundam and its pilot!」

124:7851.en: 「No good! Its speed is leagues above!」

124:7886.en: 「This machine can't\nkeep up with that speed!」

124:7992.en: 「The Super Robot name isn't for show!」

124:8072.en: 「Super Robot, my foot! Don't mock me!」

124:8115.en: 「That $$マシンキャリバー$$ is different!」

124:8250.en: 「So this is... the power of a $$スフィア$$!」

124:8505.en: 「I'll take that one even if I die!」

124:8624.en: 「I-I have to admit it...!\nThis one's strong!」

124:8737.en: 「No good!\nAt this rate I'm a sitting duck!」

124:8909.en: 「Why, out on the galaxy's frontier,\ndoes this happen to me...?!」

124:8999.en: 「Lay down a barrage!\nShake the enemy off by any means!」

124:9050.en: 「Fire, keep firing!\nIt's all we can do now!」

124:9411.en: 「No good! I have to abandon the unit!」

124:9592.en: 「M-my life... what was it all for...」

124:9625.en: 「The price of joining $$サイデリアル$$...!」

124:9718.en: 「If I lose the ship, I'll be demoted!」
